subject: Film & Cinema
title: Why Cinema Is a Visual Language
description: A quick, practical guide to Why Cinema Is a Visual Language.

hook.text: Before anyone spoke in a film, audiences already understood the story. Images are enough.

buildup.text: Cinema communicates through composition, movement, light, and color — a grammar without words.

discovery.text: Silent filmmakers proved that a well-composed image conveys emotion faster than dialogue.

twist.text: Sound and dialogue made cinema lazier — many modern films forget the power of a single image.

climax.text: The greatest filmmakers still tell their stories visually first, verbally second.

punchline.text: A picture is worth a thousand lines of dialogue.

quiz.question: Why is cinema considered a visual language?
options: It communicates through composition, movement, light, and color
